summary: B11: import / export: Jira CSV, CSV / JSON, GitHub Issues
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub-Plugins `e54a2bb`: B11: import and export (Board) — RFC 4180 CSV, Jira CSV import (repeated multi-value columns, story point fields, seconds, Jira dates, comments, parent ids), GitHub Issues import through IGitHubApi when the GitHub plugin is on (pull requests left out, closed → done / won't do, milestones → versions), ImportIssues (names mapped onto the board's types and statuses by name, shared word or kind; missing people, components and versions added; parents linked where the hierarchy allows; old keys kept; creation and resolution times kept; preview before importing; one change, undoable), CSV export (names) and JSON export (everything incl. change logs); Import Issues dialog and Export items in the board menu. 9 tests
